stem: A student wants to study primary succession by removing all the plants in a plot of irrigated farmland previously used to grow corn. What will be the MOST LIKELY result of the student’s plan?

options.label: A
options.text: The plan will be successful, because the study area includes a water source.

options.label: B
options.text: The plan will not be successful, because the study area should be smaller.

options.label: C
options.text: The plan will not be successful, because the study area should not contain soil.

options.label: D
options.text: The plan will be successful, because the study area likely contains only grasses.
